reviewAdvisory: The draft's own confidence section says the notice does not address in-transit cargo, yet the FAQ asserts as fact that the surcharge is set by time rather than vessel position, which is an inference presented as a statement of the notice.
This presents the no-grandfathering reading as settled when the draft elsewhere labels it an inference from the absence of a carve-out, so the FAQ contradicts the confidence section.

The entire article rests on one notice plus the announcement it cites, and the single-source limitation is only mentioned in passing under Inferred rather than disclosed as a sourcing constraint on the confirmed facts.
